items.title: Abbie Williams Interview, 1966-06-02
items.q: And I was hired by Boynese Briscoe.

ctx.x: Well that was uh... They jumped me up on the floor at Sam.

He was riding in Ramport, that's where we used to pass him. A guy, he was a good, a good Samurit, he used to give a good play on the card game, the Pity Pat game at Sam's where they sell those uh, those Samurit's, poor boy Sam. So they thought they'd give him a big cent off because he was a good fellow, he just took sick and he died. Uh-huh. And I was hired by Boynese Briscoe.
